title: VMF machine lease
description: WAVE-RUNNING-LEASE-1: the hold one job has on one machine, at leases/<machine key>.lease in the run. A wave worker, a restore or a rebuild makes it with the store's exclusive create, renews heartbeatUtc while it works, and removes it when it ends. The Migrations page and the wave editor read it, so a wave whose machine is held reads as running there, as it does in the engine (Get-VmfMachineHold). A lease written before version 1 had no schemaVersion; a lease lives only while its job runs, so none is kept for long.

vmId.description: The Azure resource ID of the machine, as the plan spells it. A worker also holds an availability set while it converts one of its machines: then this is 'group-avset/' and the set's ID in lower case, and no plan entry has it.

workerId.description: Who holds the machine. 'restore:<operation id>' is a restore; any other value is a wave worker.

acquiredUtc.description: When the hold was taken, ISO 8601 UTC.

heartbeatUtc.description: When the holder last renewed it, ISO 8601 UTC. A wave worker's hold older than the lease limit (900 seconds) on a machine whose state is final belongs to a worker that stopped, and the service removes it at its next check.
